text_block_list.text:
The day of the Tenno Sho (Spring) had 
arrived, the first Senior Class GⅠ race 
that promised a fierce clash against 
Mejiro McQueen.

Mejiro McQueen, aiming to fulfill her 
long-cherished wish by claiming this race, 
and Mejiro Ryan, seeking to stop her and 
prove her own true worth.

A battle where neither can afford to back 
down... begins now.
